S_kinds.S1: the FIRST boundary pop after the setter arms
S_kinds.S2: the SECOND boundary pop after the setter arms (measured for `popf` by tf0f)

P_kinds.PA: samples at the instruction-start pop and the OPCODE pop only
P_kinds.Pall: samples at EVERY decoration byte's pop and the opcode's (what the QS pins announce; what `pop_is_first` does)

B_kinds.B0: takes at RETIRES ONLY -- the ucore as landed
B_kinds.B1: a take may also land at the FIRST decoration byte's hand-over
B_kinds.Bnp: a take may also land at the PREFIX STACK's hand-over (the `0F` byte on an escaped probe)
B_kinds.Bd: a take may also land at the OPCODE's hand-over -- KM's own interpretation
B_kinds.Ball: a take may land at EVERY decoration byte's hand-over
